title: Two Countries One Heart — EN/FR/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk mbira acoustic guitar French Mandarin language learning warm baritone 106bpm brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe-Australia journey celebration
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
She brought the red dust with her.
They built a third country — the one not on any map.
Two countries. One heart.
Mufaro ndewose — happiness belongs to everyone.

[Verse 2 - French, with English translations]
Elle a apporté la poussière rouge avec elle. (She brought the red dust with her.)
Ils ont construit un troisième pays — celui qui ne figure sur aucune carte. (They built a third country — not on any map.)
Deux pays. Un cœur. (Two countries. One heart.)
Mufaro ndewose — le bonheur appartient à tout le monde. (Happiness belongs to everyone.)
Le mbira joue (The mbira plays)
Et les eucalyptus répondent (And the gum trees answer)
De Harare jusqu'à la lumière du port (From Harare to the harbour light)
Joel et Kerri (Joel and Kerri)

[Chorus - Mandarin, with English translations]
两个国家，一颗心 (Two countries, one heart)
早晨的津巴布韦 (Zimbabwe in the morning)
傍晚的澳大利亚 (Australia in the evening)
两个国家，一颗心 (Two countries, one heart)
姆比拉琴与桉树 (The mbira and the gum tree)
一起唱歌 (Singing together)
两个国家，一颗心 (Two countries, one heart)
他们需要的唯一地图 (The only map they need)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Australia got lucky. Jeff and Jill brought something real.
French: L'Australie a eu de la chance. Jeff et Jill ont apporté quelque chose de réel. (Australia got lucky. Jeff and Jill brought something real.)
Mandarin: 澳大利亚很幸运。杰夫和吉尔带来了真实的东西。(Australia got lucky. Jeff and Jill brought something real.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Two countries — one heart — yes
French: Deux pays — un cœur — oui (Two countries — one heart — yes)
Mandarin: 两个国家 — 一颗心 — 是的 (Two countries — one heart — yes)
